name: schema-violation-external-interface-member-of-wrong-kind
description: An external interface stub listing members of the kind its `external_dest` does not admit. Since contract `8.0.0` a stub lists the members its ports use by name -- `operations` only on a `CLIENT-SERVER-INTERFACE`, `data_elements` only on a `SENDER-RECEIVER-INTERFACE`, nothing on a `MODE-SWITCH-INTERFACE` (`rule:interfaces.external_interface.member-kind`) -- and this sender-receiver stub lists an operation, so what refuses is the shape of the payload.

context.summary: The `examples/basic` model. The change set creates a sender-receiver stub that lists an operation.

authorization.notes: The scope covers the create exactly, so the answer is the engine's and not the authorization boundary's.

input.intent: Carry the speed interface another file declares.

expected.notes: Refused when the payload is bound, at the element the payload creates. The repair is the field the stub's `external_dest` admits -- `data_elements` on this sender-receiver stub -- or the `external_dest` of the interface the other file really declares.
